🎓 Campus Bridge

Campus Bridge is a web-based career guidance platform designed to help students identify their strengths and improve their weaknesses through personalized assessments and learning recommendations.

The platform evaluates students in three key areas:

💻 Technical Skills
🧠 Aptitude
🤝 Soft Skills

Based on the assessment results, Campus Bridge generates a personalized learning roadmap to help students strengthen weak areas and recommends skill-matched job opportunities based on their overall performance.
